decisions.reason: Operator training builds on the core offer, costs little to run and supports machine sales and service, so its results likely meet aspirations and give no reason for problemistic search.
A fourth rotary axis is a low-cost accessory that extends the core milling systems, and it is plausibly at aspiration level given the growing industry turnover.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and its results are uncertain, but it fits the firm's future-oriented direction, and slack from a growing industry lets the firm carry it a while longer.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is central to the firm's established business and its own page signals a flagship product, so dropping it is unlikely.
The automatic tool change system strengthens the productivity value of the core machines and builds on the existing offer, so it likely performs at or above aspiration.
